actual_request.prompt:
Create ONE independently drawn complete SOUTHWEST walking frame 06/16 by editing image1. Direction fixed FRONT-LEFT THREE-QUARTER, facing diagonally down-left with both eyes visible and farther eye narrower. Keep camera, face angle, torso angle and body proportions exactly as image1. Image2 is original identity; image3 is the approved bright polished Daoist chibi painted style.
Gait: Near left leg supports weight, toe grounded behind. Far right knee moves ahead down-left of supporting leg, its small boot lifted just in front of supporting ankle, knee still bent.
Near leg means character's anatomical LEFT on the star-CARD hand side; far leg means her anatomical RIGHT on the ASTROLABE hand side. Show actual knee flexion, ankle and sole changes and corresponding robe folds. Both full boots must be visible. Gentle walking, at least one foot planted, natural short stride, no kick/run/jump. Upper body stable; small secondary hair/tassel/sleeve changes. This is a fresh walking pose, not a shifted duplicate of reference and not standing.
Preserve original star girl: red-gold star crown, small forehead star, high dark bun with flowing long dark hair, large brown-ruby eyes, black/red/ivory/gold Daoist ornate robes, star belt, short black-gold boots. Her RIGHT hand holds the original round astrolabe, LEFT hand holds exactly three physical star cards. Keep all props and geometry; no changed hand, costume or head size.
Native full single frame >=1024 square, clean genuine transparency. Whole crown/hair/equipment/boots within margins, x512 body axis and y942 ground baseline relative to1024. No shadow/floor/background/checkerboard, no colored fringe/glow/particles, no text/UI/grid/multiple figures.
